subject: [PATCH 1/6] memcg: move per-node objcg to the read-mostly fields

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch moves the per-node object cgroup pointer from the end of a struct to the start, where it can be stored on a separate cache line from frequently updated fields. This is done to reduce contention and improve performance by minimizing the number of cache misses when accessing this field. The change has no functional impact.
